title: Five Places to Go in Jerusalem
abstract: Jerusalem’s city center has transformed into a vibrant scene, with youthful, often tattooed habitués offering a curious juxtaposition to the religious pilgrims roaming the Holy City.

title: Five Places to Shop in Havana
abstract: Old Havana is a Unesco World Heritage site and about as photogenic as neighborhoods come. But its streets are also a surprising shopper’s delight.
